task_name: Multi-Object Tracking with SparseTrack vs ByteTrack
scientific_goal: Handle occlusions and improve MOT performance in crowded scenes by decomposing dense target sets into sparse subsets via pseudo-depth estimation and performing hierarchical association

named_methods.name: SparseTrack
named_methods.description: Tracking method that decomposes dense target sets into sparse subsets via pseudo-depth estimation and performs hierarchical association

named_methods.name: ByteTrack
named_methods.description: Multi-object tracking by associating every detection box (both high and low confidence scores)
key_components: low-score detection matching for occluded objects

input_data.description: Simulated multi-object video sequence with ground truth trajectories and detection boxes

output_requirements.primary: Complete trajectories for each target (identity labels and bounding box sequences across frames)
